name: claude-ask
description: Use local Claude Code as a persistent full-access coding agent or independent second opinion from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run persistent Claude Code agents and follow-ups.
interface.longDescription: Run full Claude Code agents for repository assistance, implementation, diagnosis, and reviews, with exact models, persistent jobs, and resumable follow-ups. Read-only review is optional.
defaultPrompt: Ask Opus for a quick independent opinion without repository tools.
Ask Claude to investigate and fix this issue, then run the tests.
Ask Sonnet 5.5 to inspect this implementation and run the relevant checks.
Continue the previous Claude job with a focused follow-up.
